fields.name: Speed
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x20051E0 (applies a LightDesc to a light entity) copies LightDesc+0x5C (SE: LightDesc::Speed) here, and adds/removes the component according to LightDesc+0x6D (IsFlickering); bg3.exe+0x3D3B370 uses it as the frequency: sinf(Speed*Time + seed) and sinf(Speed*1.1*Time).

fields.name: Amount
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x20051E0 (applies a LightDesc to a light entity) copies LightDesc+0x60 (SE: LightDesc::Amount) here; bg3.exe+0x3D3B370 multiplies both sines by it and writes the sum to the light object at +0xC0.

fields.name: Time
fields.evidence: Set to 0 on creation (bg3.exe+0x20066E0); bg3.exe+0x3D3B370 adds the frame delta (param_3+8) to it every update and uses it as the sine argument. Probe: 0 or about 218 s.
